note: Conditional call-forwarding codes route only UNANSWERED/BUSY/UNREACHABLE calls to your Twilio number, so your phone still rings first. Codes vary by carrier, plan, and device — ALWAYS verify with your carrier before relying on these. Replace <TWILIO_NUMBER> with your assigned number's 10 digits (no +1) unless noted.

carriers.name: Verizon
carriers.notes: *71 = conditional (no answer / busy). *72 is UNCONDITIONAL (forwards everything) — do not use that for this.

carriers.name: AT&T
carriers.enable: No answer: *61*<TWILIO_NUMBER>#   Busy: *67*<TWILIO_NUMBER>#   Unreachable: *62*<TWILIO_NUMBER>#   (or set all three: **004*<TWILIO_NUMBER>#)
carriers.notes: GSM supplementary-service codes; press Call after dialing.

carriers.name: T-Mobile
carriers.notes: Use full E.164 (+1<number>) on some T-Mobile/VoLTE configurations.

carriers.name: Google Fi
carriers.enable: Set conditional forwarding in the Google Fi app or fi.google.com (Account → Settings), not via star codes.
carriers.disable: Toggle off in the Google Fi app.
carriers.notes: Star codes are unreliable on Fi; use the app.

carriers.name: US Cellular
carriers.notes: Similar to Verizon-style codes; verify on your plan.
